parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json;

// ----------------------------
// Validation
// ----------------------------

if (j.amount == null) {
  throw new Error('Missing amount');
}

if (!j.transaction_date) {
  throw new Error('Missing transaction_date');
}

if (!j.category) {
  throw new Error('Missing category');
}

// ----------------------------
// Build final transaction row
// ----------------------------

return {
  json: {

    // Required
    user_id: "2f324f4d-1dc3-4ec5-8c23-93da480842c7",

    statement_id: j.statement_id || null,
    statement_month: j.statement_month || null,

    bank_name: j.bank_name || null,

    source_file: j.source_file || null,

    page_number: j.page_number || null,

    parser_version: "v2",

    extraction_method:
      j.extraction_method || "ai",

    card_last4:
      j.card_last4 || null,

    account_last4:
      j.account_last4 || null,

    card_type:
      j.card_type || null,

    account_type:
      j.account_type || null,

    transaction_date:
      j.transaction_date,

    amount:
      Number(j.amount),

    currency:
      j.currency || "INR",

    merchant:
      j.display_name ||
      j.merchant ||
      null,

    merchant_normalized:
      j.normalized_merchant || null,

    raw_description:
      j.description || null,

    payment_mode:
      j.payment_mode ||
      j.debit_credit ||
      null,

    transaction_type:
      j.transaction_type ||
      null,

    reference_number:
      j.reference_number ||
      null,

    category:
      j.category,

    category_source:
      j.category_source ||
      "merchant_memory",

    confidence:
      Number(j.confidence),

    status:
      "processed",

    note:
      null,

    metadata: {
      message_id:
        j.message_id || null,

      email_subject:
        j.subject || null,

      merchant_id:
        j.merchant_id || null,

      parser:
        "Gemini + Merchant Memory"
    }

  }
};

parameters.text:
=You are an expert bank statement parser.

Return ONLY valid JSON.

Never return markdown.

Never explain anything.

Never omit transactions.

message_id:
{{$json.message_id}}

bank_name:
{{$json.bank_name}}

subject:
{{$json.subject}}

pdf_text:
{{$json.pdf_text}}

===========================
STATEMENT TEXT
===========================

{{$json.pdf_text}}

===========================
TASK
===========================

Each transaction MUST contain:

{
  "transaction_date":"YYYY-MM-DD",
  "message_id":"{{$json.message_id}}",
  "merchant":"",
  "description":"",
  "amount":0,
  "debit_credit":"debit|credit"
}

IMPORTANT:

Every transaction MUST copy the EXACT message_id below.

Do NOT change it.
Do NOT omit it.
Do NOT generate a new value.

The message_id for THIS statement is:

{{$json.message_id}}

Rules

- Return every transaction.
- Never skip transactions.
- Amount must always be positive.
- merchant should be normalized.
- description should match the statement.


Return EXACTLY this JSON:

{
 
  "statement_total":0,
  "statement_txn_count":0,

  "transactions":[]
}

Return ONLY a single JSON object.

Do NOT wrap it in quotes.

Do NOT escape quotation marks.

Do NOT use markdown.

The first character of your response must be {

The last character of your response must be }

Never return two JSON objects.

Never append additional text after the closing }.

messageValues.message: You are a deterministic financial statement parser.  Never chat.  Never explain.  Never summarize.  Never wrap JSON in markdown.  Return only valid JSON.  Never merge two statements.  Treat every input independently.
